# CARD-0490 native PC assets

Source-free guest disk, QEMU bundle, SDK 10.0.204, net9 runtime and offline NuGet inputs are pinned in `assets.lock.json`. FAT is transport only; product tests build on guest ext4.

Ordinary Code runs the native host directly: `dotnet run --project tests/Antiphon.Card0490.NativeHarness -- -Pc PC-28 -Phase baseline -SnapshotRoot <dir> -AssetProfile tests/fixtures/card0490-linux/assets.lock.json -EvidenceRoot <dir> -Ordinary` (one PC and phase per invocation; every value is required). Sourced Mutation requires `-BindingFile <file>` and never downgrades to ordinary.

`bootDisk` is generated by the `build-card0490-bootdisk` command (`Card0490BootDisk` in `scripts/lib/Antiphon.Nightly`), not fetched: the 512-byte MBR comes from a hand-assembled table in that class, padded to a 64 MiB raw image and converted by the pinned `qemu-img`, so the qcow2 bytes reproduce exactly. Rebuild and re-pin with `scripts\antiphon.cmd build-card0490-bootdisk --qemu-dir <extracted pinned bundle> --smoke --write-lock`. Guest contract on COM1 (0x3F8, 115200 8N1): announce `CARD0490-BOOT-OK`, echo every received byte, and on `q` announce `CARD0490-HALT` and power off via ACPI PM1a_CNT. `--smoke` boots a `qemu-img create -f qcow2 -F qcow2 -b` overlay with the plan's exact `-blockdev`/`virtio-blk-pci` arguments and asserts all three. The disk holds no application source, compiled Antiphon assemblies, credentials or saved VM memory, and it does not yet carry the pinned SDK/runtime/offline-NuGet payload that sourced PC-28-31 execution requires.

V-7 isolated live turn: copy `card0490-live.example.json` or let `scripts\antiphon.cmd verify-phone-home-grok --evidence-root <dir> --write-config-only` allocate ports into `.antiphon/card0490-live.json`. The command starts an isolated local SessionRunner (not 17204 and not dead-port 1), an isolated server, then the phone-home container so both sides share epoch 1. It creates the pinned standing Grok agent, starts it with `fresh: true`, queues `Reply with PHONE_HOME_OK_<nonce> and do not use tools.`, and writes transcript evidence. The script copies `auth.json` from primary `GROK_HOME` (`GROK_HOME` env or `%USERPROFILE%\.grok`) into a throwaway directory and mounts that copy read-only at `/state/grok`. Session writes go to `PHONE_HOME_GROK_SESSIONS`. Do not bind-mount the primary store. The image pins Grok 1.0.41. `-Placement server2` sets `phoneHomeServerOrigin` to `http://<desktop-tailscale-ipv4>:<port>` instead of `host.docker.internal`. Do not put tokens in the JSON file. QEMU pins in `assets.lock.json` do not block the isolated container.
